units.source_text: 此时小公子将进宫去。

en.t: At this time, the young lord was about to go to the palace.

units.source_text: 他先来参见父亲，周身值宿打扮，童发下垂，倒比正式打扮时结成总角美观得多。

en.t: He first came to pay his respects to his father, dressed for night duty, and with his boyish hair hanging down he looked far more handsome than when it was formally tied in double loops.

units.source_text: 大纳言看了觉得非常可爱，便叫他带口信给住在丽景殿的女儿：

en.t: The Dainagon saw him and found him very charming, so he asked him to carry a message to his daughter who lived in the Reikeiden:

units.source_text: “你对大姐说：我叫你代我前来请安，我今夜不能进宫了，因为身体不大好。”

en.t: Say to your elder sister: I have sent you to call on her in my place, because I am not feeling very well and cannot go to the palace tonight.

units.source_text: 又笑道：“把笛子练习一下再去吧。

en.t: Then he laughed and said, Practice the flute a little before you go.

units.source_text: 皇上不时要召你到御前演奏，你的笛子还未熟练，不好意思。”

en.t: His Majesty may summon you from time to time to play before him, and it would be embarrassing if your flute playing were still unpracticed.

units.source_text: 便叫他吹双调。

en.t: He then had him play in the sojo mode.

units.source_text: 小公子吹得非常好听。

en.t: The young lord played very beautifully.

units.source_text: 大纳言说：“你的笛子吹得渐渐好起来了，全靠在这里常常和人合奏之故。

en.t: The Dainagon said, Your flute playing has gradually improved, all because you often play together with others here.

units.source_text: 现在就和姐姐合奏一曲吧。”

en.t: Now play a piece together with your sister.

units.source_text: 便催促帘内的女公子弹琵琶。

en.t: He then urged the young lady behind the curtain to play the biwa.

units.source_text: 女公子狼狈不堪，就用手指轻轻拨弦，略弹一曲。

en.t: The young lady was terribly flustered, and with her fingers she lightly plucked the strings and played a brief piece.

units.source_text: 大纳言用低钝而驯熟的声音合着音乐吹口哨。

en.t: The Dainagon whistled along with the music in a low, dull, but practiced voice.

units.source_text: 忽见东边廊檐近旁一株红梅，正在盛开，便说道：

en.t: Suddenly he noticed a red plum tree near the eaves of the eastern corridor, blooming at its height, and said:

units.source_text: “这庭前的花特别可爱。

en.t: The flowers before this garden are especially lovely.

units.source_text: 匂兵部卿亲王今天在宫中，折取一枝去送给他吧。

en.t: Prince Niou Hyobukyo is in the palace today, so break off a branch and take it to him.

units.source_text: ‘梅花香色好，惟汝是知音’呢。”

en.t: The plum blossoms are fine in scent and color; only you truly understand them.

units.source_text: 又说：“唉，从前光源氏荣任近卫大将、声势鼎盛的时候，我正是像你那样年纪的一个童子，常常追随左右，

en.t: He went on, Ah, long ago, when Hikaru Genji held the honored post of Captain of the Guards and was at the height of his power, I was a boy just about your age and often attended him at his side,

units.source_text: 这情景使我永远不忘。

en.t: and that sight has stayed with me forever.

units.source_text: 这位匂兵部卿亲王也是世人所极口称颂的，其品貌确也值得受人赞誉，

en.t: This Prince Niou Hyobukyo is also praised extravagantly by everyone, and his character and appearance are indeed worthy of admiration,

units.source_text: 然而总觉得不及光源氏之一端，也许是我一向确信光源氏天下无双之故。

en.t: yet somehow he seems not to equal even one part of Hikaru Genji, perhaps because I have always been convinced that Genji was without peer in the world.

units.source_text: 我对他的关系并不深切，然而想起了也悲痛无有已时。

en.t: My connection with him was not especially deep, yet whenever I think of him my grief never ends.

units.source_text: 何况对他关系亲密的人，被他遗弃在这世间，恐怕都在讨厌自己寿命太长吧。”

en.t: How much more, then, must those who were close to him, left behind by him in this world, be lamenting that their own lives have lasted too long.

units.source_text: 谈到这里，历历追思往事。

en.t: As he spoke to this point, memories of the past rose vividly before him.

units.source_text: 感伤之余，不觉意兴索然。

en.t: Overcome with melancholy, he unconsciously lost all spirit for the occasion.

units.source_text: 大约此时他已情不自禁立刻命人折取一枝红梅，交小公子送去。

en.t: Around this time, unable to restrain himself, he at once ordered someone to break off a branch of red plum and gave it to the young lord to deliver.

units.source_text: 说道：“今已无可奈何了。

en.t: He said, There is nothing to be done now.

units.source_text: 这位深可恋慕的光源氏的遗念，现今只有这位亲王。

en.t: The only living reminder now of the deeply beloved Hikaru Genji is this prince.

units.source_text: 从前释迦牟尼示寂之后，其弟子阿难尊者身上放光，道行高深的法师都疑心他是释迦复活。

en.t: In the past, after Shakyamuni entered nirvana, his disciple the venerable Ananda emitted light from his body, and even monks of profound practice wondered whether Shakyamuni had returned to life.

units.source_text: 我为了欲慰怀旧之情，也要烦渎这位亲王了。”

en.t: In order to console my longing for the past, I too must trouble this prince.

units.source_text: 便赋诗奉赠，诗曰：

en.t: He then composed a poem and respectfully sent it; the poem said:
